extension.summary: Unofficial Tastemade videos and optional live TV
extension.description:
Browse VOD shows, movies, seasons and episodes with programme artwork, summaries and clear navigation.
Use an eligible Tastemade account to play entitled, provider-declared unencrypted HLS videos. Your profile can reuse its viewing session, verify sign-in and sign out locally.
Optional live TV opens the current channel list directly and uses compatible InputStream Adaptive. Live TV is off by default; installation or enabling is offered only with your consent when you choose Play.
Keeps Kodi's native views and playback controls. Includes original generic icon and background artwork, not official service branding.
extension.disclaimer: Independent, unofficial add-on; not affiliated with or endorsed by Tastemade. Service/content names identify their respective owners. Eligible account permissions are required; no purchase, DRM or region bypass is provided. Password masking does not encrypt saved settings. Media/session URLs may appear in native Kodi or player logs; review logs before sharing and protect reusable credentials. Original artwork is not a legal guarantee of trademark clearance.
extension.news: Prepared the permanent plugin.video.tastemade identity and standalone installation guide. Earlier development builds use a separate settings profile; sign in again after installing this add-on. Includes VOD and season browsing, optional direct InputStream Adaptive live TV and original icon/fanart.
